title: Stained Glass
look: Jewel-coloured glass in heavy lead came, glowing from behind.

doc.essence: A church window: saturated jewel glass lit from behind, held in thick dark lead.
doc.notIt: Not glass (opaque jewel tones, heavy lead), not ink (dark lead on a dark stage, glowing fills).
doc.colour: Saturated +35 % with a bright radial centre.
pitfalls: Lead and eyes share a colour: eyes need a light part around them.
